request.description: Refine ONLY THE HEAD of this otherwise liked Sprig gardening robot. The user says it looks TOO LITERALLY like a mailbox. Make it read primarily as a cool compact ROBOT HEAD, keeping only a subtle hint of the original rounded-box silhouette. Reduce the tall arched postal-box roof shape: use a lower gently rounded/angular robotic housing with a clearer expressive mechanical face panel or visor and small integrated eye sensors. Remove any literal mail slot, postal door/handle, flag or mailbox-front details. Keep the existing head size/body proportion and attachment, no enlarged cute head. Retain the @ identity only as a subtle existing emblem, not a mail label. Do not add human features, hair, extra antennae or intricate mechanical clutter. Preserve the rest of the current design as closely as possible: exact body, claws, garden trowel/cultivator/watering attachments, pose, feet and colors. Maintain the same clean bold pixel outlines, simple broad flat shading and restrained approved palette. No white/light-gray speckles, tiny noisy details, gradients, text or scenery. Whole character and tools inside the unchanged transparent 192x192 canvas.

status: Staged v2 head refinement for user visual review; original retained. No model image inspection.
